services.desc: “A lot of instructors really go above and beyond the training requirements. They want you to succeed. They truly have your best interests in mind.”~ S. Zuk, graduate The private licence is for those who want to fly for fun, with family and friends. If you purchase a helicopter, you can use your own to learn to fly. With 16 helicopters, Chinook has one of the largest training fleets in Canada. This ensures aircraft are always available, minimizing delays from maintenance and keeping your training on schedule. Chinook provides an exclusive in-house ground school with dedicated support, an uncommon advantage that prepares students for Transport Canada exams. Our experienced staff is committed

blurb: Chinook Helicopters offers ATO-certified flight training programs for commercial helicopter and airplane licences. Training includes expert mentorship, hands-on learning, and flexible scheduling. Programs prepare students for airline careers and include on-site pilot examiners and Transport Canada written exams.
